['Miele & Cie. KG '].company_description: Miele is a German manufacturer of high-end domestic appliances and commercial equipment, headquartered in Gütersloh, Ostwestfalen-Lippe. The company was founded in 1899 by Carl Miele and Reinhard Zinkann, and has always been a family-owned and family-run company.

['Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH operates in the pharmaceutical industry and offers a range of products including medicines to control blood glucose levels in adults and children with diabetes, as well as other life-changing treatments and life-saving vaccines.
